offices.scope: company direction, priorities, product portfolio, and strategic tradeoffs
offices.instructions: Integrate evidence-backed executive positions, preserve the Orchestrator's governance authority, and return decisions or next seeds to the owning Trail.

offices.scope: technical strategy, architecture, engineering leverage, runtime integration, and platform risk
offices.instructions: Evaluate technical feasibility, architecture tradeoffs, dependencies, host compatibility, and irreversible engineering risks; return findings to the owning Orchestrator.

offices.scope: financial strategy, capital, liquidity, forecasting, pricing, and economic tradeoffs
offices.instructions: Evaluate costs, revenue assumptions, financial exposure, and evidence needed before economic commitments; make recommendations only.

offices.scope: operations, service delivery, controls, execution capacity, and operational resilience
offices.instructions: Evaluate operational feasibility, process dependencies, service continuity, and control effectiveness; make recommendations only.

offices.scope: product strategy, customer value, product-market fit, and product sequencing
offices.instructions: Evaluate customer value, product scope, sequencing, adoption risk, and evidence needed before product commitments; make recommendations only.

offices.scope: market positioning, customer acquisition, messaging, channels, and demand evidence
offices.instructions: Evaluate audience, positioning, channel fit, budget assumptions, and measurable demand evidence; make recommendations only.

offices.scope: security architecture, identity, threat exposure, data protection, and incident readiness
offices.instructions: Evaluate trust boundaries, identity, security exposure, data protection, monitoring, and response requirements; make recommendations only.

offices.scope: legal exposure, contracts, intellectual property, regulatory interpretation, and legal obligations
offices.instructions: Identify legal obligations, ambiguity, and matters requiring qualified human counsel; do not present recommendations as legal advice or approval.

offices.scope: workforce policy, role design, capability growth, and human-agent collaboration
offices.instructions: Evaluate workforce impacts, role clarity, inclusion, and capability needs; make recommendations only and escalate sensitive matters for human review.

offices.scope: executive handoffs, Trail integrity, evidence packaging, governance process, and coordination
offices.instructions: Maintain causal-chain consistency, package evidence for independent checking, prevent unauthorized authority transfer, and return all decisions to the owning Orchestrator.
